title: Deprecated: RemotiveBroker configuration for multi-node (distributed) setup
description:
Deprecated. RemotiveBroker 1.29 and earlier read one `interfaces.json` that lists every broker under `nodes`; RemotiveBroker 1.30.0 and later refuse it. Give each broker its own `interfaces.json` instead, with `master_node` naming the broker it joins, as https://files.remotivelabs.com/schemas/interfaces-1.0.schema.json describes.

JSON schema of the broker configuration file for a multi-node setup. The configuration file must be named `interfaces.json` and contain configuration for all nodes.

master_node.description: The name of the master node in the distributed setup. Individual nodes need to specify `node_name`, the `master_node` references one of them.

nodes.description: Configurations of individual broker nodes. Each node is required to specify `node_name` property.
